principle: One compact context ribbon groups Sector, Scope, Overlay, and Tool controls into one visual band while preserving their separate logical dimensions.

layout.visual: One ribbon container under the title bar; groups are separated by small labels and vertical dividers, not by separate horizontal strips.
layout.active_state: Filled blue for primary active context; pale fill for available context; disabled grey for unavailable context.
layout.breadcrumb: Maintain compact breadcrumb: Sector × Scope × Overlay × Tool × Classification × Object.

data_binding.tree_filter: Tree remains full-depth by default; context filters what center panel and inspector show.
data_binding.center_panel: Selected node rendered through selected tool and context.
